name: Sparks - A Tale of Ink
source:
After the so-called Sovereign ascended the world’s throne as a new God, strange powers awoke in everyone inhabiting the planet.

Zhangken, a student interested in this very history, has his doubts about the truthfulness of the existing records on this tale.

He stumbles upon a clue that steers him onto a road of discovery. Truths that were buried never to be uncovered, await him.

Mysteries, monsters and the very workings of the world are standing between him and his goals. Yet luckily, he does not have to overcome these ordeals by himself, as his friends have his back along the way.

[From [url=https://sparks-fvn.itch.io/sparks-a-tale-of-ink]Itch.io[/url]]
